name: contract-inline-examples
goal: Read compact examples beside contract field types, with ellipsis for long values and a trailing info action for full details.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Tables show Name, Type and compact Example; long values ellipsize. A trailing info action retains full examples and descriptions in the existing modal.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing contract tests require descriptions inline and examples only in dialogs. Update the same component and responsive cases with a long shared fixture, trailing actions and full modal descriptions.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Sealed red 28ec858d at bb6fff22 fails because the Example column is missing, across desktop, tablet and mobile. The same test inputs and environment are frozen for green.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Opus implemented inline example previews and a pinned trailing info column; full descriptions/examples stay in the existing modal. Focused component and responsive browser checks pass.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Sealed red e3119d67 at 057c0240 exposes hidden examples and clipped actions. Unchanged green beef845c at 890e82c0 passes across three viewports; the same 1,257 inputs and environment are frozen.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
